text:
Maya Chen: heads-up team — planning a public announce for the 'Orbit' release on Thu 2025-11-20 10:00am PT. need final changelog URL, docs anchor, a 1-line bench hero + two callouts, and the webinar signup flow wired. who can own eng handoff?
Priya Desai: I can own the changelog + docs publish. propose changelog freeze Wed 6pm PT, docs live by Wed 11:59pm PT.
Alex Rivera: timeline OK. will publish under https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1979 and add #changelog anchor once live.
Jordan Patel: engineering will avoid internal codenames in public notes. bench tests will be included in appendix. will add canary playbook link when ready.
Samira Khan: marketing asks: 1) one-line bench highlight for hero, 2) two short technical callouts (hw & workload), 3) blog + tweet drafts, 4) signup modal with UTM and lead-tier routing. I'll draft once numbers confirmed.
Linh Tran: tagging announce-bot to schedule rolling window after docs go live. announce-bot: please queue canary at announce time with 90m watch.
announce-bot: scheduled canary 2025-11-20T10:00:00-08:00, watch 90m, notify: #eng-oncall #eng-sre.
Maya Chen: inbound routing specifics: route leads to APAC-SDR if inferred_region == "ap-southeast-1"; Enterprise SDR if company_size >50 OR plan_hint == "enterprise"; EDU/GOV -> Partnerships. compute hidden field lead_tier as enterprise|mid|self-serve in JS.
Samira Khan: will wire lead_tier and pass account metadata to HubSpot. need exact field names from eng for embed.
Alex Rivera: fields exposed: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint. use those exact names.
Jordan Patel: bench context: tests run on g5.12x and a100-40gb mix, seq_len=1024, steady-state batch=24, warm KV cache. observed p99 down 18.9%, throughput per-dollar up ~1.9x with quant-E + prefix caching. note: small single-token calls unaffected.
Samira Khan: marketing will round to: "~19% lower p99 latency; nearly 2x throughput per dollar." will include exact matrix in notes.
Maya Chen: webinar CTA copy: "Register for the 11/22 Orbit deep-dive — live demo + benchmarks" link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=orbit1979. include lead_tier and account_id as hidden params.
Samira Khan: draft tweet options: A) "Orbit release: faster and cheaper inference — register for our deep-dive 11/22: [link]" B) "~19% lower p99, ~2x throughput/$ — Orbit deep-dive 11/22: [link]". will post in doc.
Alex Rivera: sample JSON for blog embed (paste as code block): ```{"release":"orbit-1979","p99_reduction":"18.9%","throughput_per_dollar":"1.9x","hw":"g5.12x/a100-40gb"}```
Jordan Patel: rollout plan: canary 5% at t0, 30% at +45m, 100% at +120m if SLOs stable. monitoring: p99, error_rate, qps, cost_per_token. fallback: `fallback_policy: auto_revert_on_error(1.3x)` and manual rollback window 30m.
Linh Tran: ops note: if error_rate >1.3x baseline during watch window, auto-swap to previous model. will share playbook link in #marketing when uploaded.
Priya Desai: press/embargo: PR wants embargoed assets Tue 9am PT. Samira, mark assets EMBARGOED and include a short methodology appendix.
Samira Khan: will do. marketing assets needed: 1) blog draft + hero image 2) bench visuals (PNG+SVG) 3) tweet variants 4) webinar slide with chart 5) embed modal HTML. target to post drafts Wed 12:00 PT for review.
Maya Chen: final checklist: Priya drop docs link here when live; Jordan share canary playbook link; Samira post blog + social drafts by Wed noon for review. everyone avoid internal codenames in public copy.
Alex Rivera: will drop final docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1979#changelog by Wed 23:50 PT.
Jordan Patel: canary playbook link (shared): https://redwood.ai/internal/eng-releases/canary-1979.md (will grant marketing access).
Samira Khan: ack. aiming for Wed 12:00 PT drafts. will embed the sample JSON and the UTM'd CTA in the blog draft. :rocket:
Maya Chen: thanks all — will check back Wed morning for a quick pulse and signoff. :thumbsup:
